From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Q3 renewal hygiene: account-level forecast sweep & churn verification

Team,

Quick reminder as we close June: Finance needs a clean, defensible Q3 renewal forecast by EOD Friday so we can finalize headcount/ARR commitments for the planning doc. Please do the following for any accounts you own or cover by Friday 6/30 5pm PT: 

- Confirm current Opportunity Stage in HubSpot and set a single canonical "renewal_probability" (%). If there are differing signals between Sales/CS, add a 1-sentence rationale in the notes.
- Flag any accounts with active churn signals (exec change, budget review, PO delay, procurement redlines) and add one-line evidence (who said what / date).
- Update ARR delta in the attached Q3_renewal_rollup_deltas.xlsx (sheet: OWNER_EDITS) — only change the BLUE cells.

I've attached the rollup template and the Acme-specific churn brief from last week's calls. Core ask: we need the book-level forecast to reconcile with the pipeline commit column tomorrow so FP&A can lock the numbers.

If you have mitigation plays (credits, short-term pilots, exec touchpoint dates), list them inline under the account row. Where probability changes > 20 points, add a short cause (e.g., procurement stuck — awaiting contract).

I'll be pulling a reconciliation report on Friday morning and will ping owners whose rows are missing updates.

Attachments: [Q3_renewal_rollup_deltas.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [acme_churn_notes_20270630.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — NAO

--
